Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (including limited theatrical releases, streaming premieres, and festival debuts). These picks span a range of styles—from gritty neo‑noir to high‑stakes heist dramas—and have received praise from critics and audiences alike.

| # | Title | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling, time‑juggling saga that blends crime history with Scorsese’s signature storytelling. |
| 2 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II | A courtroom thriller that doubles as a political drama, with razor‑sharp dialogue and strong ensemble performances. |
| 3 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Hugh Grant | Ritchie’s fast‑paced, witty take on the British gangster world, with a clever plot twist. |
| 4 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A tense psychological thriller that explores the consequences of false accusations in a small Danish town. |
| 5 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a crime‑thriller edge that keeps viewers on edge. |
| 6 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime drama that examines justice, betrayal, and gender dynamics in medieval France. |
| 7 | **The Nightingale** | Jennifer Kent | Lily James, David Wenham | A gritty, atmospheric thriller set in 19th‑century Tasmania, blending crime with a haunting narrative. |
| 8 | **The Last Full Measure** | James Gray | Tom Hanks, Michael Keaton | A war‑crime thriller that follows a veteran’s quest for justice against a corrupt system. |
| 9 | **The Last of Us** (TV series) | Craig Mazin | Pedro Pascal, Bella Ramsey | Though a TV series, its crime‑thriller elements and strong character arcs earned it critical acclaim. |
|10 | **The Last of Us** (video game adaptation) | N/A | N/A | The game’s narrative depth and moral complexity make it a standout crime‑thriller experience. |

### How to Watch

- **Streaming**: *The Irishman* (Netflix), *The Trial of the Chicago 7* (Netflix), *The Gentlemen* (Amazon Prime Video), *The Invisible Man* (Netflix), *The Last Duel* (Netflix), *The Last of Us* (HBO Max).
- **Theatrical/Physical Media**: *The Hunt* (limited release, available on Blu‑ray/DVD), *The Nightingale* (DVD/Blu‑ray), *The Last Full Measure* (DVD/Blu‑ray).
- **TV Series**: *The Last of Us* (HBO Max).

These titles represent a mix of mainstream blockbusters and indie gems, offering a variety of crime‑thriller sub‑genres to suit different tastes. Happy watching!
